OpenAI's 6 October 2026 catalogue reports: Proves Bloch's T^3/2 law with its exact coefficient for three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnets at every positive quantum spin, allowing nonnegative symmetric finite-range couplings whose support generates ℤ^3. The thermodynamic limit precedes the zero-field derivative and low-temperature limit. The family also proves spontaneous magnetization for nearest-neighbor models in every dimension d ≥ 3 and determines the first lattice correction for three-dimensional nearest-neighbor couplings. entry.description: OpenAI Math family 303, Weak pure infiniteness and Cuntz-algebra absorption. OpenAI's 6 October 2026 catalogue reports: Resolves the ordinary-to-strong pure-infiniteness question of Kirchberg and Rørdam for complex C^∗-algebras. For exact algebras, proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element also suffices.
